searches: Moldova sistem comenzi online restaurant ridicare de la local precomandă preț lei/lună Chișinău software

vendors.name: Vitrina
vendors.reason: White-label ordering website/app + POS (pickup, orders for a set time, own domain) with its own price page for Moldova in MDL; developer Complete Solution s.r.o. (Trnava, Slovakia) per its main page ('Vitrina is developed by Complete Solution, a company based in Slovakia.'), hryvnia is the main page's default currency

eligibility.order_quote: Order ahead on the website and pick up without queuing
eligibility.country_quote: Currency of this price list: Moldovan Leu (MDL).

plans.note: No subscription; 3% of online payments (delivery and pickup), as on the main page. 'Prices exclude VAT.'

Price block shows three amounts (billed monthly first, then cheaper for longer billing periods); the first, monthly-billed amount is recorded. Start includes 'Ordering website on your own domain' and 'Delivery and pickup'. Up to 0.9% of online payments only (main page). 'Prices exclude VAT.'
Monthly-billed amount (first of three). Adds table QR ordering and booking.

answers.quote: Delivery, pickup and orders for a set time
Orders for a set time and pickup
Your venue's Wi-Fi and social links on the website
Kitchen display on a tablet: stations, timers and Ready
From 2 to 10 locations in one city: one system, a shared menu and separate records for each location.
Your domain, logo and colours: guests see your brand, not ours
At most 0.9% (3% with no subscription) of what guests pay online through your acquirer.

notes: One eligible tool with an MDL price: Vitrina (white-label ordering site + POS, developed by Complete Solution s.r.o. in Slovakia; its own Moldova price page in MDL: Express MDL 0/mo + 3% of online payments, Start MDL 789/mo monthly-billed, Restaurant MDL 1,589/mo, excl. VAT; pickup and orders for a set time) — a restaurant tool, not a food-truck tool. No Moldovan-made ordering tool found: the Romanian search returned Glovo stores (marketplace, never), MENU TIGER /ro (agent 6, USD — not fetched) and an investment-agency PDF catalogue with no restaurant ordering prices. Poster: no Moldova page (https://joinposter.com/en/pages/md-main 404; no Moldova in its selector). Paloma365's country selector names Moldova but it shows no pickup ordering (see KZ). FoxiFood, Storekit, SumUp do not list Moldova. Stop rule applied.
